editorial.blurb: Don Pancho serves authentic Mexican street food with homemade tortillas, welcoming service, and the kind of real flavor that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask if it's your first visit—they'll bring you a complimentary homemade tortilla with beans and salsa as a special welcome. Also, catch the pozole on weekdays when available; it's usually a Sunday-only special.

topDishes.note: slow-braised pork that melts in your mouth
marinated pork with brightness of pineapple and seasoning
hearty, rich with tender meat and hominy
